items.summary: Update post-login redirect logic so that after signup/login: (1) if the Firestore user profile has approved == false, navigate to /pending-approval; (2) if approved == true, ALWAYS navigate to /chat for all roles including admin and super_admin, and do not auto-redirect any admin/super_admin to /users or any admin page.

Make /chat the default landing screen for all approved users and implement the Chat Home empty state with the exact user-facing text: "Start a conversation. Tap + to find users." and a bottom-right Floating Action Button (FAB) with a plus/new-chat icon that navigates to /users when clicked.

Change /users to be a single "User List" experience for all roles that lists ALL approved users (normal, admin, and super_admin), including the currently logged-in user (do not exclude self). Each row must show the user's profile photo, name, and may show a small optional role badge.

Implement the chat request UX logic on /users so that tapping a user row does NOT open a chat directly; instead it reveals a "Send Chat Request" action, and sending creates a chat_request record with fields { fromUid, toUid, status: "pending", createdAt } (preserve existing naming conventions in Firestore, but ensure these exact semantics and values).

Implement request handling so the receiver is notified in the UI of incoming pending chat requests, can Accept or Reject, and: Accept creates a 1-to-1 chat thread accessible to both users; Reject does not create a chat thread. Ensure chat becomes enabled/visible for both users only after acceptance.

Separate admin access from the normal chat flow: normal users must not see any admin dashboard/features; admin dashboard must be accessible only via the header profile dropdown item labeled "Admin Dashboard" and only visible to admin/super_admin users. Admin features must never change the post-login redirect flow or the default /chat landing behavior.

Ensure role/identity semantics: treat super_admin as BOTH an admin and a normal user for product behavior, meaning super_admin users (and admins) must be included in the approved user list and have access to normal chat flow; normal users must not gain any admin-only capabilities.

Safety constraints: do not delete any existing user documents; do not modify existing user roles or approval flags as part of this change; preserve and respect the current super_admin bootstrap logic.

Apply a cohesive, non-blue/non-purple visual theme across the updated /chat and /users experiences (colors, typography, spacing), keeping the UI consistent with the existing Tailwind + shadcn components and ensuring the FAB is visually prominent and accessible.
